verdicts.evidence: lines 609-650: Find free rooms and Book room submit handlers call the api; retry (618) reruns the search; change-time (619) focuses the start field; Switch to room (635-645) reselects; Book another room (646-650) returns to the form.

lines 408-417: rooms, floors, capacity and features rendered from api.findRooms result; lines 581-592: confirmation built from the createBooking result. No hardcoded sample records or placeholder text.
lines 410-411: legend restates date, time span and people above the room list; lines 427-429: 'room, when, people' line sits directly above Book room (210-211). All on one page.

lines 379-384 save criteria, title, catering, note and room to sessionStorage on every change; lines 657-668, 675 restore them and rerun the search on reload; failed booking (545-558) leaves fields untouched.

lines 351-357: defaults are next quarter hour, 1 hour, 4 people; catering checkbox unchecked (200); line 491 preselects smallest fitting room. Enter runs a search or the booking the user is filling in; nothing destructive or costly is defaulted.
lines 145-214: criteria, room choice, details and Book room are all on one screen with no dialog or extra page; room is preselected (491) so booking is search, title, book.
lines 148-220: sections are when/how many, free rooms, meeting details (title, catering, note), and the booked confirmation. Each maps to a task in the brief; no stat cards, tips or extra panels.

line 181: one primary (Find free rooms) in the search section; line 211: one primary (Book room) in the details section; retry, change-time, switch and Book another room are all class secondary (401, 404, 407, 443, 219).
No action deletes, overwrites or is irreversible; the only actions are search, select, book and start another booking.
lines 387-390: aria-disabled is set only while the button's own request is in flight (460, 540). When no room is chosen, Book room stays usable and line 519 shows the reason directly above it.
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
All visible strings (146-219, 398-411, 441-442, 519, 555) concern booking a room; none mention the implementation, mock data, the request or unfinished features.

line 173 'Ends ...' under Length informs the length choice; lines 441-442 catering conflict sits under the catering checkbox with the action to take; line 406 stale notice sits with its re-search button. No standing banners or disclaimers.

No text narrates the screen. Remaining guidance is one short line at its control: 'Choose a room that can, or untick this.' (442) and 'Find free rooms and choose one, then book.' (519) in error context.
line 173 helper gives the end time, not a restatement of 'Length'; legend (410-411) adds count and criteria to the 'Free rooms' heading; no subtitle or helper repeats its label.
Headings 'Book a meeting room', 'Free rooms', 'Meeting details', 'Room booked' (146, 187, 192, 217). No greetings, slogans, exclamation marks or congratulations.

Labels: 'Find free rooms' (181), 'Book room' (211), 'Try again' (401), 'Choose another time' (404), 'Find free rooms again' (407), 'Switch to <room>' (443), 'Book another room' (219). All verb-first; no OK/Submit/Done.

Features are mapped to user words (306-311) and no enum or field names show, but line 591 displays the raw server id (e.g. bk_48213) as 'Booking reference'. First reading: an ID shown as a value; second reading: a reference users would quote. Verdicts differed.

line 400: 'Could not check which rooms are free. The connection to the booking system dropped.' with Try again; line 555: '<room> is not booked ... Try booking again.'; field errors 369-374 name the fix. The raw ECONNRESET text is never rendered.

Error strings at 369-374, 400, 441-442, 519, 555 use 'Could not', 'is not booked', 'has passed', 'Choose', 'Enter'. No 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals; the 'Error: ' prefix (70) is neutral.
lines 402-404: zero rooms shows 'No rooms are free on <when> for <n> people.' with a 'Choose another time' button that moves focus to the start time (619).
lines 397-407: loading, failed load (alert with Try again), no rooms for the criteria (Choose another time) and stale criteria (Find free rooms again) each have their own message and action.

lines 463-475: failed search renders the error with Try again in the results area, criteria kept; lines 545-557: failed booking shows the message above Book room, all fields kept, button re-enabled for retry.

lines 458-461: status set to loading, button label 'Finding free rooms...' and results text shown before the await; line 540: 'Booking...' before the await. Calls last at most 1.5s so no progress or cancel is needed.
lines 397-398: while status is loading only 'Finding free rooms...' is rendered; the empty message (402) is rendered only after the response sets status to empty (479-481). No zero counts shown.

lines 103, 126, 131: overflow-wrap anywhere on room name, booking line and dd values; grid column 1fr with min-width 0 (49, 88); rooms with no features show 'No equipment' (308); empty note row is omitted (590).
lines 379-384 write the draft to sessionStorage on every edit (509, 626-633); lines 657-668 restore criteria, title, catering, note and chosen room on return or reload, so unsaved edits are kept.

Title is capped at 120 characters (195) and the note at 500 (207) with no text saying so; 'today or later', 'later time' and 'whole number of 1 or more' appear only as errors after submit (370-374). No rule is stated under a label beforehand.

line 206: note labelled '(optional)' and has no required attribute; date, start, people and title are unmarked and carry required (153, 158, 178, 195); catering is a checkbox worded 'Ask for catering' (201).
validateCriteria runs only inside findRooms on submit (454); title is checked only in book (523). Input handlers only clear errors (612, 628); nothing validates on keystroke.

lines 154, 159, 179, 196: each field has its own error paragraph directly beneath it, filled by setError (325-331); marked by an 'Error: ' text prefix (70), bold text and a 2px border (67), not colour alone.
Client rejection returns before any change to values (455, 523-527); server rejection (545-558) only sets messages and focus. Fields are cleared only by resetForm after a successful booking (563).

line 455 focuses the first invalid criteria field; lines 524-525 and 547-548 focus the title; setError sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby (328-330). Catering conflict focuses the checkbox, described by catering-msg (200, 530).
Neither submit button is ever disabled before completion; aria-disabled is set only in flight (460, 540). Submitting incomplete input shows field errors (369-374, 524) or 'No room is chosen' (519).

line 514: book returns at once if state.booking is true; line 453: findRooms returns if status is loading or a booking is in flight; both buttons show a busy label and aria-disabled during the request (460, 540).

lines 458-461 and 539-540 change the button label and results area synchronously before the await; room selection toggles the chosen style at once (621-626); validation errors render synchronously (455, 524).

Success replaces the form with 'Room booked' and the booking details (566, 581-596); search shows the room list or the empty message; every failure path renders a message (400, 470, 519, 547, 551, 555).
No success toast, banner or dialog. The 'Room booked' view (216-220) is the result itself, and the announce region (222) is visually hidden.
Errors render in place (400 in the results area, 448 above Book room, field paragraphs) and stay until the user acts again; there are no timers that dismiss messages and no toasts.
No action removes, archives or moves existing data; changing the chosen room is a plain selection with no confirmation (621-627).
The interface has no delete, overwrite, irrecoverable send or payment; creating a room booking (542) is the task's own confirm step, with the room, time and people listed beside the button (427-429).
No confirmation dialogs: no confirm() calls and no dialog elements in the file.
No optimistic updates: the done view is shown only after createBooking resolves (542-566) and the room list only after findRooms resolves (463-493).
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
No modal dialogs in the markup or script.
lines 146-183: the page opens on the h1 and the when/how-many form, followed by free rooms (186) and meeting details (191) in task order; nothing decorative precedes them.
line 146 heading 'Book a meeting room' is followed directly by the search form (148-183); no hero, greeting or introductory panel.
No stat cards, summary metrics or charts; the only number is the room count inside the results legend (410).
The room list has no optional filter, sort or search to clear; it exists only as the result of the required criteria, which the legend restates with the count (410-411).

All controls are native inputs, select, radios, checkbox and buttons inside forms (149-212); room choice is a radio group (414); focus is moved programmatically after errors and view changes (455, 525, 595, 600). No click-only widgets.

Errors carry an 'Error: ' text prefix and bold weight (69-70) plus a thicker border (67); the chosen room is shown by the checked radio as well as colour (102, 105); success has a tick and the words 'Room booked' (217).

Loading text (398) and the stale notice (406) go into #results, which is not a live region, and are not sent to #announce; error alerts (400, 448) are role=alert containers created together with their message, not present beforehand. Only 482, 495, 531, 632 use the status region.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; the only chooser is a native select (163).

lines 133-140: under 560px the when grid becomes one column, the dl stacks, and the main buttons go full width; inputs are width 100% (55), long names wrap (103, 126, 131); no fixed widths wider than the viewport and no dialogs.
